test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following teams won the Cricket's Inaugural Women's Premier League 2023?
solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is **Mumbai Indians**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mumbai Indians won the Cricket's Inaugural Women's Premier League in 2023.**
 
• **​The team is owned by Indiawin sports.**
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur is the team captain, and Charlotte Edwards is the team coach.**
 
• The team defeated **Delhi Capitals** in the championship game to win the inaugural WPL season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Women's Premier League started in 2023, and Mumbai Indians were the champions in the inaugural season.
 
• **Mumbai Indians is a men's team in the Indian Premier League (IPL) and is owned by India's biggest conglomerate, Reliance Industries. **
 
• The Women's Premier League is a new initiative to promote **women's cricket **in India and provide a platform for talented players to showcase their skills.

1b
